title: Machine Room
reference: repeat 3 { repeat 3 { forward } jump activate turn_right }
hints: The room spirals up. Each side is the same: walk, climb, hit the switch, turn.
Loop the walk inside a loop of sides. The last climb lands on the exit.
repeat 3 { repeat 3 { forward } jump activate turn_right }

story.intro: VANTA: "The machine room. Every switch you flip here, I flip back. Good luck."
story.outro: PATCH: "Machine room's ours. Elevator's moving again. Next stop, the Workshop."
